text: What the world dare only think?  Teacups clinkedked and manners  blinked between the size of not quite love. [singing] She stitched with ink. A wild  rebellion beneath lace gloves. The merit always wed to truth and irony. A quiet night  behind the smile. Dear Jane, they said, >> "Sweetain, [music and singing] >> the books don't bow, nor blush, nor bend." And every dashing duke  she made became a fool by the end. >>  >> She knew the price of being good too and gently crashed the parlor  doors
With sharp and women loud  and whisper.  Oh.     Oh. >>   >> So now we sit and sip and turn  her pages soft as thunder. Wonder.
